name: OWASP_A06_Log4j_JNDI_Exploit
search: index=web_logs OR index=proxy | eval payload=urldecode(_raw) | regex payload="(?i)\$\{jndi:(ldap|rmi|dns|nis|nds|corba|iiop):\/\/" | stats count values(http_user_agent) as user_agents values(payload) as payload_sample by src_ip, dest_ip, uri_path
description: OWASP A06: Log4j JNDI yukleri vasitesile RCE hucumlarini tespit eder.
